summary: Iteration 4 tested deployment under the /order subdirectory, using a local nginx at http://localhost:9080 that simulates the VPS main nginx (static prod build with PUBLIC_URL=/order, API on 127.0.0.1:8102 with COOKIE_PATH=/order). I also ran a regression check on the preview root path. Everything I tested passed. Subpath: '/' returns LANDING PAGE and /presensi/ returns PRESENSI PHP. /order redirects with 301 to /order/. Assets load from /order/static/..., and /order/login-bg.jpg loads (naturalWidth 1400). Admin login redirects to /order/admin. All 9 admin sidebar links keep the /order prefix. Direct loads and F5 on /order/admin/orders, /products, /reports, /notifications, /order/app/rekap and /order/app/orders/<id> work. Logout goes to /order/login. Cookies access_token, refresh_token (httpOnly) and csrf_token have Path=/order. Through the UI I created product TEST_SUB86793 and reseller TEST_Sub Reseller 86793 with a login. The reseller is forced to /order/ganti-password, then lands on /order/app. Qty 5 is rejected with an inline error and the cart is kept; qty 10 is accepted and redirects to /order/app/orders/6aecc34675810c038191d8b6 (RL-061126-0019). Admin recorded 2 payments (400k + 600k) and 2 shipments (4 pcs + rest) with PNG receipt uploads. Receipt images use src http://localhost:9080/order/api/files/resi/<uuid>.png and render for both admin and reseller. Status changed to Selesai/Lunas automatically. I changed the product price from 100k to 150k; the old order stays at grand_total 1,000,000. Rekap CSV downloads. Laporan, Notifikasi WA and Profil load. Webhook POST /order/api/webhooks/fonnte with /cekorder returns {status:true}, and the 'Cara Cek Order' help reply appears in Notifikasi WA. Across all browser sessions, the network capture found 0 API requests containing '/order/api/api' or missing the /order prefix. Preview regression: pytest test_relaylab_core.py + test_multi_txn.py passed 20/20. Preview UI login, dashboard, order detail with receipt images and navigation all work; cookies there use Path=/.
critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking: the qty-min rejection in the reseller cart is checked only in the client (no 4xx request was sent). Server-side enforcement was verified in earlier iterations.
Non-blocking: client_ip() trusts X-Real-IP first. This is safe only because the backend is bound to 127.0.0.1 behind nginx, which overwrites the header. Keep the docker port binding at 127.0.0.1.
Non-blocking: there are no DELETE endpoints for products, resellers or orders, so TEST_ data from this run (and earlier ones) stays in the shared DB.
